structuredContentSummary.accountingSemanticsNote: Operational period summary based on invoice issueDate and expense date. Draft and cancelled invoices are excluded from issued revenue. currentlyMarkedPaidTotal sums invoices issued in the period whose current status is 'paid'; it does NOT measure cash collected during that calendar month (e.g. an invoice issued in September and paid in October belongs to the September issueDate cohort). issuedCohortCurrentlyPaidMinusExpenses is an issueDate-cohort difference, not treasury cash flow or accounting profit. Expenses are partitioned into deductible (taxDeductible === true), non-deductible (taxDeductible === false), and undetermined classification (taxDeductible absent/null) without assuming deductibility by default. Multi-currency totals are kept in separate currency buckets without conversion. Regulated tax-filing figures are omitted.

draftInvoices.note: Draft invoices are non-issued working documents and are excluded from issued revenue.

issuedInvoices.note: Invoices are selected by issueDate within the period. currentlyMarkedPaidTotal sums invoices issued in this period that are currently marked as paid; it does NOT measure cash collected during this calendar month (e.g. an invoice issued in September and paid in October belongs to the September issueDate cohort). Unpaid totals represent nominal invoice amounts not marked as paid; real outstanding balance cannot be determined without partial-payment or bank-reconciliation records.

expenses.note: Expenses are partitioned into deductible (taxDeductible === true), non-deductible (taxDeductible === false), and undetermined classification (taxDeductible absent, null, or non-boolean) without assuming deductibility by default.

draftInvoices.note: Draft invoices are non-issued working documents and are excluded from issued revenue.

Unpaid totals represent nominal invoice amounts not marked as paid; real outstanding balance cannot be determined without partial-payment or bank-reconciliation records.

expenses.note: Expenses are partitioned into deductible (taxDeductible === true), non-deductible (taxDeductible === false), and undetermined classification (taxDeductible absent, null, or non-boolean) without assuming deductibility by default.

notes: Invoice figures compare issueDate cohorts for each period; issuedCurrentlyPaidDelta compares invoices issued in each period that are currently marked as paid, not cash collections by payment date.
